points.title: 出生与成长
points.description: 比莉·哈乐黛在纽约出生并长大。她的家庭环境复杂，这对她后来的音乐生涯产生了深远影响。在青少年时期，她开始接触爵士乐，并逐渐展现出音乐天赋。
points.descriptionEn: Billie Holiday was born and raised in New York. Her family environment was complex, which had a profound impact on her later musical career. During her teenage years, she began to get involved with jazz and gradually showed her musical talent.

points.title: 音乐生涯起步
points.description: 比莉·哈乐黛在1930年代初期开始她的音乐生涯。她签约了第一份唱片合同，并在纽约的夜总会和酒吧中表演。她的独特嗓音和即兴演唱技巧很快引起了人们的注意。
points.descriptionEn: Billie Holiday began her musical career in the early 1930s. She signed her first recording contract and performed in nightclubs and bars in New York. Her unique voice and improvisational skills quickly caught people's attention.

points.title: 签约蓝调传奇
points.description: 比莉·哈乐黛签约了著名的蓝调唱片公司Blue Note Records。她的专辑《Lady Sings the Blues》成为她的代表作之一，展示了她深沉的情感和独特的演唱风格。
points.descriptionEn: Billie Holiday signed with the famous blues record company Blue Note Records. Her album 'Lady Sings the Blues' became one of her representative works, showcasing her deep emotions and unique singing style.

points.title: 艺术巅峰
points.description: 比莉·哈乐黛在1940年代达到了艺术巅峰。她的音乐风格和演唱技巧得到了广泛认可，成为爵士乐坛的标志性人物。她的专辑《Billie Holiday at the Apollo》进一步巩固了她的地位。
points.descriptionEn: Billie Holiday reached the peak of her art in the 1940s. Her musical style and singing skills were widely recognized, making her a landmark figure in the jazz world. Her album 'Billie Holiday at the Apollo' further solidified her position.

points.title: 晚年生活与逝世
points.description: 比莉·哈乐黛在晚年遭遇了健康问题和药物滥用。尽管如此，她依然坚持音乐创作和表演。1959年，她在纽约逝世，享年44岁。她的音乐遗产和对爵士乐的贡献至今仍然被人们铭记。
points.descriptionEn: Billie Holiday faced health problems and drug abuse in her later years. Despite this, she still persisted in musical creation and performance. She died in New York in 1959 at the age of 44. Her musical legacy and contribution to jazz are still remembered today.

supporter.zh: 比莉·哈乐黛被视为爵士乐坛的传奇人物，她的音乐才华和情感表达深深影响了无数音乐家和听众。她的精神遗产在于她对音乐艺术的执着追求和独特风格。
supporter.en: Billie Holiday is regarded as a legendary figure in the jazz world, her musical talent and emotional expression deeply influencing countless musicians and listeners. Her legacy lies in her dedication to musical art and her unique style.

critic.zh: 批评者认为比莉·哈乐黛的生活充满了悲剧，她的药物滥用和健康问题影响了她的音乐生涯。她的某些歌曲也因涉及社会问题而受到争议。
critic.en: Critics argue that Billie Holiday's life was filled with tragedy, with her drug abuse and health problems affecting her musical career. Some of her songs have also been controversial for their involvement in social issues.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和大众文化中，比莉·哈乐黛被定义为爵士乐的重要代表，她的音乐风格和演唱技巧对后来的爵士乐发展产生了深远影响。她也是一个复杂的人物，她的生活故事和音乐作品都充满了矛盾和冲突。
objective.en: In the academic and popular culture, Billie Holiday is defined as an important representative of jazz, with her musical style and singing techniques having a profound impact on the development of jazz. She is also a complex character, with her life story and musical works filled with contradictions and conflicts.

self.zh: 音乐是我的生命，是我存在的意义。
self.en: Music is my life, the meaning of my existence.

others.zh: 比莉·哈乐黛的声音就像夜空中最亮的星星，照亮了爵士乐的天空。
others.en: Billie Holiday's voice is like the brightest star in the night sky, illuminating the sky of jazz.
